scope.frame: B186's Fricke trace-map spectra at the lock's depths
scope.object: the kappa = 2 band's box dimension against the off-axis one

claim_one_line: B186'S BAND DIMENSION RE-GRADED (Review 67, R66-4): at lambda = 0 the operator is Hermitian, so the band's spectrum is real, and B186's lock box-counted it in two dimensions after rescaling noise-level imaginary parts (1e-15) to unit range -- the value moved with the BLAS thread count; counted on the line it is 0.9385 (golden) and 0.8830 (silver) at both settings, against the off-axis 0.8272 and 0.7646, so B186's ordering stands by 0.11-0.12; its lock counts the band on the line and its printed band values carry a dated note. 0 of 19.
